source.title: ios tailscale 8787 port can not open

content: Reusable troubleshooting workflow for Tailscale remote service access failures: First confirm the target port is listening locally on the host, then verify basic Tailscale connectivity between client and host, then check the service's own authentication/whitelist configuration, then check Tailscale ACL rules for port-level restrictions, and finally check host firewall rules and SYN packet behavior for the target port.
